title: Virginia Issued Air Permits for Data Centers
summary: Virginia DEQ's registry exposes issued air permits for data-center generation by facility and records the current general permitting and testing guidance applied to this equipment.
key_findings: The registry makes named data-center air permits discoverable from an official state rail.
The page records revised generator best-available-control-technology and performance-testing guidance effective in 2026.
Permit issuance precedes equipment construction, testing, compliance reporting, enforcement, and facility operation.
why_it_matters: The registry converts a broad emissions question into a project-level environmental and compliance trail.
ftfn_relevance: Adds named permit discovery to the compute-corridor shelf.
Links onsite power resilience to air regulation and measured compliance.
Creates a follow-on path for testing, modifications, operating hours, and enforcement.
evidence_limits: An issued permit is not proof that authorized generators were built or tested.
The registry does not establish continuing compliance or measured emissions.
Permit capacity is not grid service or data-center operating capacity.
